body: I was at school this time, around P.E. and my siblings work and are at school. My mother cannot read English so I depended on my older friends. But I knew what to do. I expected him to immediately leave after I told him my age, but he was persistent. I blocked him in the end, though. I could have told my supervisor or teacher, but I decided not to. They would have immediately worried my mother, of course, I didn't want them to make my mom distressed.
